小发现：靠近太阳的行星，通常更快绕完一圈。太阳是一颗会发光的恒星。: Little discovery: planets nearer the Sun usually complete an orbit faster. The Sun is a star that shines.

我们要去地球的身边，绕着地球转圈圈。点下面的大按钮，让火箭出发！: We’re going to fly around the Earth! Tap the big button below to launch our rocket.
升空之后，还要向旁边加速哦。: After lift-off, we need to speed up sideways.
为什么不会掉到地上？: Why doesn’t it fall to the ground?
地球一直把飞船往下拉。飞船也一直向前飞，快到能绕着圆圆的地球不停地“落下去”！: Earth keeps pulling the spacecraft down. It is also moving forwards so fast that it keeps falling around our round Earth!

你好，我是太阳！我会发光、发热。八颗行星都围着我转圈圈。: Hello, I’m the Sun! I shine and give out warmth. Eight planets travel around me.
我是小小的水星。我住得离太阳最近，绕太阳跑得很快！: I’m little Mercury. I live closest to the Sun, and I travel around it very quickly!
我是金星，穿着厚厚的云衣服。我的地面非常非常热！: I’m Venus. I wear a thick blanket of clouds. My ground is very, very hot!
我是地球！蓝蓝的是大海，绿绿的是陆地。你和家人就住在我身上。: I’m Earth! My oceans are blue and my land is green. You and your family live here with me.
我是火星，看起来红红的。小机器人正在我的地面上探索呢！: I’m Mars, the red planet. Little robots are exploring my ground!
我是大大的木星。我身上有一道道条纹，还有一个大大的风暴！: I’m big Jupiter. I have colourful stripes and a very big storm!
我是土星！我戴着漂亮的环，环里有好多冰块和小石头。: I’m Saturn! I wear beautiful rings made of lots of icy pieces and little rocks.
我是天王星，穿着蓝绿色衣服。我歪得很厉害，像躺着一样！: I’m Uranus. I’m blue-green, and I’m tilted so far over that I look as if I’m lying on my side!
我是海王星。我离太阳最远，蓝蓝的身上刮着很大的风。: I’m Neptune. I’m the planet farthest from the Sun. I’m blue and very windy!
太阳是恒星，不是行星。: The Sun is a star, not a planet.
绕太阳一圈：大约 88 天。: One trip around the Sun takes about 88 days.
金星的地面比水星还热。: Venus has a hotter surface than Mercury.
绕太阳一圈：一年。月亮绕着地球转。: One trip around the Sun takes a year. The Moon travels around Earth.
木星是太阳系里最大的行星。: Jupiter is the biggest planet in our Solar System.
土星环不是一块完整的圆盘。: Saturn’s rings are made of separate pieces.
天王星的自转轴倾斜得很厉害。: Uranus has a very tilted spin axis.
八颗行星里，海王星离太阳最远。: Of the eight planets, Neptune is farthest from the Sun.
火箭喷出热热的气体，把自己向上推。我们离开地面，飞高一点！: The rocket pushes hot gas down, which pushes the rocket up. We leave the ground and climb higher!
火箭飞高了，慢慢转弯。它开始向旁边飞，还要继续加速！: The rocket is higher now. It turns gently and starts flying sideways. We still need to speed up!
用完的火箭部分先分开。上面的发动机继续推，让飞船向旁边飞得越来越快！: The empty part of the rocket separates. The engine above keeps pushing, so the spacecraft goes faster and faster sideways!
速度够啦！发动机停下来，飞船和上面的火箭分开，继续向前飞。: We’re fast enough now! The engine stops. The spacecraft separates from the rocket and keeps moving forwards.
飞船正在绕着地球转圈圈！地球的引力一直拉着它，它也一直快快地向前飞。: The spacecraft is travelling around Earth! Earth’s gravity keeps pulling it down, while it keeps moving forwards very fast.
一起倒数：三、二、一！: Count with me: three, two, one!
准备好啦，小火箭马上出发！: Ready! Our little rocket will launch very soon.
正在看这一步，点“继续动画”就能接着飞。: Explore this step. Tap “Continue the flight” when you’re ready.
约 200 千米高的圆轨道示例：约 7.8 千米/秒。: Example: a circular orbit about 200 km up needs around 7.8 km/s.
示意速度 · 先飞高，再向旁边飞快。: Illustrated speed · First climb, then speed up sideways.
你好，小小宇航员！我们一起去太空玩吧！: Hello, little astronaut! Let’s play in space together!
太阳和八颗行星一起转圈圈。点一点星球，和它打招呼吧！: The Sun and eight planets are travelling together. Tap a planet and say hello!
和小火箭一起出发吧！先向上飞，再向旁边加速。: Let’s go with our little rocket! First fly up, then speed up sideways.
